newsitem.title: NORWAY: Norwegian shares take downturn on U.S. GDP data.
newsitem.headline: Norwegian shares take downturn on U.S. GDP data.

text.p: Norwegian shares backtracked into negative territory on Wednesday following stronger-than-expected first-quarter GDP figures from the United States.
The Total share index fell almost five points to stand at 1,091.32 points at 1255 GMT, a decline of 0.13 percent from Tuesday's close.
The index had traded around 1,096 points for most of the session before the data.
Volume at 1255 GHMT was a light 621 million crowns.
